extras: Runs local helper processes (Python/PowerShell) to change OS window properties.
intentEvidence: Show Obsidian's graph view as your desktop wallpaper.
problem: Users want a dynamic, visual representation of their knowledge network that is visible outside of the Obsidian application window.

relations.evidence: Choose the graph: the core Graph view, or the Advanced Graph View community plugin if you have it installed

summary: Graph Wallpaper displays the live, dynamic Obsidian graph view as a slowly rotating desktop wallpaper on supported operating systems.
